definitions.explanation: The set of implements used in the Japanese tea ceremony, including the tea bowl, whisk, scoop, and other items.

examples.japanese: {茶道具|さどうぐ}を{揃|そろ}える。
この{茶道具|さどうぐ}は{祖母|そぼ}から{受|う}け{継|つ}いだものだ。
examples.english: These tea utensils were passed down from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}で{江戸時代|えどじだい}の{茶道具|さどうぐ}の{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of Edo-period tea utensils at the art museum.

notes:
Compound of {茶|さ} (tea, in its on'yomi reading used in {茶道|さどう}) and {道具|どうぐ} (tools, utensils). Refers collectively to the implements used in {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony).

KEY ITEMS:
- {茶碗|ちゃわん}: tea bowl
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}: bamboo whisk
- {茶杓|ちゃしゃく}: tea scoop
- {棗|なつめ}: thin tea container
- {水差|みずさ}し: water jar
- {柄杓|ひしゃく}: ladle
- {釜|かま}: kettle

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to gather tea utensils
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}{一式|いっしき}: a full set of tea utensils
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}{屋|や}: tea utensil shop
- {古|ふる}い{茶道具|さどうぐ}: antique tea utensils

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fine {茶道具|さどうぐ} are valued as art objects and can be extremely expensive. Famous pieces are given individual names and have documented histories spanning centuries.
